info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Deposit Lending By Param1-spec
info.description: The Deposit Lending Retrieval API allows users to access specific deposit lending information based on fiduciary agreement parameters. This endpoint supports financial institutions and developers seeking to retrieve detailed data related to deposit lending agreements by providing a unique identifier. Typical consumers include banking software developers and financial analysts who require accurate and timely information for analysis or integration into other financial services. By utilizing this API, clients can enhance their decision-making process and improve service offerings tailored to their customers' financial needs.

get.summary: Retrieve fiduciary agreement details by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the details of a fiduciary agreement using its unique identifier. It provides specific information about the agreement, including its terms, parties involved, and any associated transactions.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the required parameters to retrieve details regarding the fiduciary agreement with the specified identifier. Ensure that all necessary fields are populated to receive a successful response.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the fiduciary agreement details.
